target.title: fix(discord): messages sent during gateway reconnect are silently dropped
target.body:
Closes #56610

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Discord outbound messages sent while the gateway websocket was reconnecting (close codes 1005/1006 during network blips or Discord-side resets) would fail and never be delivered. The failed sends landed in the durable outbound delivery queue as pending entries, but nothing on the Discord side ever drained that queue after the gateway came back, so the messages were silently dropped from the user's perspective. WhatsApp and Telegram already drain their queued deliveries on reconnect; Discord was the gap.

## Why This Change Was Made

Two small, config-free changes inside the Discord plugin, mirroring the existing WhatsApp/Telegram reconnect-drain pattern:

1. `withDiscordDeliveryRetry` now treats a send failure as retryable when the account's registered gateway reports `isConnected === false`, so in-flight sends ride out short reconnect windows instead of failing immediately. The gateway is looked up with the resolved account id (the same id the lifecycle registers under, fixing the default-account lookup gap flagged on the earlier attempt in #94320), and connectivity is re-read per retry attempt so the loop stops treating errors as transport blips once the gateway is back. `DiscordError` (HTTP 4xx client errors) stays non-retryable.
2. The gateway lifecycle's status observer now fires an `onReconnect` hook on every connected transition after the initial READY, which drains pending `discord:<accountId>` queue entries via the shared `drainPendingDeliveries` SDK runtime helper. The initial connection is excluded because startup recovery already replays queued sends.

No new config surface, no protocol changes, no core changes; everything stays inside `extensions/discord` plus the existing plugin SDK seams.

## User Impact

Messages an agent sends during a Discord gateway reconnect are now delivered once the connection is re-established instead of being silently lost. Operators no longer need to restart the gateway or manually replay the delivery queue after a network blip.

## Evidence

- New unit tests:
  - `extensions/discord/src/retry.test.ts`: statusless transport errors retry while the registered gateway is disconnected; no retry when connected; `DiscordError` stays non-retryable either way; `withDiscordDeliveryRetry` end-to-end with a registered disconnected/connected gateway.
  - `extensions/discord/src/monitor/provider.lifecycle.test.ts`: reconnect (websocket reopen -> READY) triggers exactly one `drainPendingDeliveries` call with `drainKey: "discord:default"` and a selector matching discord entries (including entries with an unset account id) while rejecting other channels; the initial connection triggers no drain.
- Focused run: `pnpm test extensions/discord/src/retry.test.ts extensions/discord/src/monitor/provider.lifecycle.test.ts` — 2 files, 48 tests passed.
- Full plugin suite: `pnpm test extensions/discord` — 163 files, 1871 tests passed.
- Typecheck: `pnpm tsgo:extensions && pnpm tsgo:extensions:test` — clean.
- Lint/format: `scripts/run-oxlint.mjs` on touched files and `oxfmt --check` — clean.
- Known proof gap: no live Discord reconnect reproduction was captured for this PR (that was the blocker that stalled #94320). The reconnect-drain path is exercised by the lifecycle test at the same seam the real gateway debug/READY events flow through; happy to assist with a live repro run if maintainers want one before landing.
